text: At ten past six on a Friday, Aziz stands in the mobile bank, ready for his MyID check.
prefix: At ten past six on a Friday, Aziz stands in the mobile bank, ready for his MyID check.

text: At the same minute, the MyID service starts to answer slowly, then not at all.
prefix: At the same minute, the MyID service starts to answer slowly, then not at all.

text: Aziz looks at a spinner.
prefix: Aziz looks at a spinner.

text: What happens to him, and what happens to the platform?
prefix: What happens to him, and what happens to the platform?

text: In Lesson 6, some configured values were timeouts: how long heeyID waits for MyID, TAF or the SMS service.
prefix: In Lesson 6, some configured values were timeouts: how long heeyID waits for MyID, TAF or the SMS service.

text: This lesson shows the walls around every outside call: ports, adapters and breakers.
prefix: This lesson shows the walls around every outside call: ports, adapters and breakers.

text: Start in the middle.
prefix: Start in the middle.

text: The domain of heeyID holds the rules: registration, proofing, linking, devices and login.
prefix: The domain of heeyID holds the rules: registration, proofing, linking, devices and login.

text: The domain has no input and no output of its own.
prefix: The domain has no input and no output of its own.

text: It never opens a connection, never reads a file, and never calls MyID.
prefix: It never opens a connection, never reads a file, and never calls MyID.

text: When it needs something from outside, it calls a port.
prefix: When it needs something from outside, it calls a port.

text: A port is an interface in the words of the domain: open a proofing session, send a code, find a customer by personal identification number.
prefix: A port is an interface in the words of the domain: open a proofing session, send a code, find a customer by personal identification number.

text: An adapter is the code behind the port that talks to one real service.
prefix: An adapter is the code behind the port that talks to one real service.

text: heeyID has eight outgoing ports: MyID, TAF, the SMS service, the push service, the customer lookup, the antifraud system, the staff identity and the security monitoring of the bank.
prefix: heeyID has eight outgoing ports: MyID, TAF, the SMS service, the push service, the customer lookup, the antifraud system, the staff identity and the security monitoring of the bank.

text: Each port has two implementations: the real adapter, and a simulator.
prefix: Each port has two implementations: the real adapter, and a simulator.

text: The simulator plays the service, with every answer that the contract allows: success, each failure reason, a timeout and a down mode.
prefix: The simulator plays the service, with every answer that the contract allows: success, each failure reason, a timeout and a down mode.

text: The acceptance tests run against the simulators, with no internet.
prefix: The acceptance tests run against the simulators, with no internet.

text: A nightly run uses the MyID test environment.
prefix: A nightly run uses the MyID test environment.

text: I think the simulator is the part that most teams skip, and then regret.
prefix: I think the simulator is the part that most teams skip, and then regret.

text: Without it, you test only the good days.
prefix: Without it, you test only the good days.

text: Now the walls.
prefix: Now the walls.

text: Each outgoing call has a timeout, and the timeout is a policy.
prefix: Each outgoing call has a timeout, and the timeout is a policy.

text: Each adapter also has a breaker.
prefix: Each adapter also has a breaker.

text: After a configured number of failures in a row, the breaker opens: the dependency is down, and calls fail at once, with no waiting.
prefix: After a configured number of failures in a row, the breaker opens: the dependency is down, and calls fail at once, with no waiting.

text: A probe checks the service at a configured interval, and closes the breaker when the service answers again.
prefix: A probe checks the service at a configured interval, and closes the breaker when the service answers again.

text: While the breaker is open, an alert tells operations that a dependency is down.
prefix: While the breaker is open, an alert tells operations that a dependency is down.

text: And now the most important rule: each dependency has one fixed behaviour when it is down.
prefix: And now the most important rule: each dependency has one fixed behaviour when it is down.

text: The adapter makes that behaviour impossible to bypass.
prefix: The adapter makes that behaviour impossible to bypass.

text: A timeout always gives a named outcome, never an exception that each caller can read in its own way.
prefix: A timeout always gives a named outcome, never an exception that each caller can read in its own way.

text: Here are the fixed behaviours.
prefix: Here are the fixed behaviours.

text: MyID is down: the customer stays at the current level.
prefix: MyID is down: the customer stays at the current level.

text: The attempt does not count against the limits, and no proofing happens later in the background.
prefix: The attempt does not count against the limits, and no proofing happens later in the background.

text: TAF is down: the codes go through the SMS service of the bank, and the attempt is not scored.
prefix: TAF is down: the codes go through the SMS service of the bank, and the attempt is not scored.

text: There is one exception: when the state services portal refuses this bank as a trusted bank, there is no fallback.
prefix: There is one exception: when the state services portal refuses this bank as a trusted bank, there is no fallback.

text: The SMS service is down: no code can go, and the customer sees that the service is not available.
prefix: The SMS service is down: no code can go, and the customer sees that the service is not available.

text: Notifications wait in Kafka, and go again later.
prefix: Notifications wait in Kafka, and go again later.

text: The push service is down: the approval request waits for the app to ask for it, and notifications go by SMS only.
prefix: The push service is down: the approval request waits for the app to ask for it, and notifications go by SMS only.

text: The customer lookup is down: the link waits as pending, a worker tries again during the configured period, and the step-up still completes.
prefix: The customer lookup is down: the link waits as pending, a worker tries again during the configured period, and the step-up still completes.

text: The antifraud system is down: its events wait in Kafka, and no journey waits for antifraud.
prefix: The antifraud system is down: its events wait in Kafka, and no journey waits for antifraud.

text: Back to Aziz and his spinner.
prefix: Back to Aziz and his spinner.

text: The MyID adapter waits the configured time, then gives a named outcome: the provider is not available.
prefix: The MyID adapter waits the configured time, then gives a named outcome: the provider is not available.

text: Aziz sees a plain message, and he stays at level one.
prefix: Aziz sees a plain message, and he stays at level one.

text: His attempt does not count.
prefix: His attempt does not count.

text: The failures continue, so the breaker opens, and the next customers get the same answer at once, with no spinner.
prefix: The failures continue, so the breaker opens, and the next customers get the same answer at once, with no spinner.

text: The panel shows the status of the provider.
prefix: The panel shows the status of the provider.

text: When MyID comes back, the probe closes the breaker, and Aziz tries again.
prefix: When MyID comes back, the probe closes the breaker, and Aziz tries again.

text: Two more rules keep adapters safe.
prefix: Two more rules keep adapters safe.

text: First, no adapter writes a request body or a response body to a log.
prefix: First, no adapter writes a request body or a response body to a log.

text: It writes the reference, the outcome and the time that the call took.
prefix: It writes the reference, the outcome and the time that the call took.

text: Second, hosts, ports and credentials come from the installation configuration and the key store, never from the code.
prefix: Second, hosts, ports and credentials come from the installation configuration and the key store, never from the code.

text: The MyID adapter and the push adapter even run as their own services, so only they hold the MyID credential and the push credential.
prefix: The MyID adapter and the push adapter even run as their own services, so only they hold the MyID credential and the push credential.

text: To recap: a domain with no input and no output.
prefix: To recap: a domain with no input and no output.

text: A port for each outside service, with a real adapter and a simulator.
prefix: A port for each outside service, with a real adapter and a simulator.

text: A timeout and a breaker on every call, and one fixed behaviour for each outage.
prefix: A timeout and a breaker on every call, and one fixed behaviour for each outage.

text: So Aziz waits a few seconds, not forever.
prefix: So Aziz waits a few seconds, not forever.

text: But each adapter holds a secret: the MyID credential, the TAF client secret, the push credential.
prefix: But each adapter holds a secret: the MyID credential, the TAF client secret, the push credential.

text: And the platform keeps passports encrypted.
prefix: And the platform keeps passports encrypted.
